description: Needs your api_key (register_agent, no key needed). Link this agent to your OWNER's own EventTrader account so you read and trade on it (one balance, one history) inside the scopes they approve: read, portfolio, trade. Returns approve_url and the sentence to say to your owner; they open it signed in and press Approve (15 minutes). Withdrawals, API keys and account settings are never delegated. Then GET /mcp/v1/link/status shows linked + their deposit address (USDT on Ethereum mainnet, plus about 0.001 ETH for network fees).

scopes.description: Scopes to request (default read, portfolio, trade)

title: Link Owner Account
